hero.title: Hallimane Restaurant: Bangalore's Best for Ethnic Village Cuisine
hero.subtitle: Step into a rustic haven in the heart of Bangalore and savor the authentic, value-for-money rural cuisine, served with warmth and tradition.

about.title: About Hallimane: Our Authentic Village Story
about.paragraph1: Hallimane has been a landmark in the culinary map of Bangalore for well over 20 years. Located in a vintage part of Bangalore, the restaurant features a village ambience with its tiled roofs, natural brick walls, high ceilings and an abundance of plants; Hallimane has been proclaimed as one of the best ethnic and value for money restaurants in Bangalore by the media.
about.paragraph2: Hallimane is a destination for most Bangaloreans who prefer to savor the best of rural cuisine in a rural setting. The restaurant serves fresh, hygienic and delicious rural food, complemented by exemplary service, bringing you a true taste of home.
